summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation filed a Form 6-K with its Q1 2026 earnings release and financial statements, reporting record revenue of $650.7 million, operating cash flow of $520.4 million, and net income of $468.6 million. The filing also notes Tom Albanese's appointment as Chair following David Harquail's retirement. There are no deal terms, no acquisition/divestiture, no tender offer, no activist campaign, and no strategic review; the filing is a routine periodic report of financial results and a board chair transition in the ordinary course. No special situation event is present.
